scope: Fix the render-pipeline one-command tool so a staged patched wrapper build stages its real patched candidate (top-level candidate-stripped.so) instead of the pinned copy in native-probe/, record staged library hashes in the evidence, and add a selectable host-cpu sRGB expectation. Re-run the full six-patch stack on the 4 KB and 16 KB AVDs and confirm the pinned build is unchanged. Software Vulkan emulator only; no phone/Adreno result claimed.

changes.library_resolution: candidate: <build>/candidate-stripped.so -> <build>/candidate.so -> <build>/native-probe/candidate.so; baseline: <build>/baseline-stripped.so -> <build>/native-probe/baseline.so; auxiliary libraries from <build>/native-probe with a recorded fallback to the pinned build's native-probe.
changes.evidence_recording: staged_libraries (candidate/baseline source path, file name, sha256, bytes, resolution order, pinned hash match, override flag; auxiliary directory and fallback) plus staged_sha256/staged_bytes/source_path in matrix.targets and a loud WARNING when an alternate build would stage the pinned candidate 574cfb4d….
changes.srgb_host_convention: --srgb-host-convention {encoded,linear} (default encoded) selects the host-cpu sRGB expectation in --run and --dir and is recorded in the receipt; no other checker semantics changed.
changes.allow_failures: --allow-failures completes a run with expected negative-control checker failures instead of aborting, and records them under results.expected_failures.
changes.consistency: Resolution mirrors tools/tests/vulkan-wrapper-validation.py (candidate-stripped.so / candidate.so / libvulkan_wrapper.so order, pinned native-probe fallback) and tools/tests/vulkan-wrapper-reference.py (pinned hashes 2494cda2…/574cfb4d…).

tool.self_test: 25 checks, 0 failed (adds selection order, override precedence, native-probe fallback, pinned-candidate warning, auxiliary fallback and both sRGB conventions).

bug.symptom: prepare_stage always staged <wrapper-build>/native-probe/{candidate,baseline}.so, so a full-stack render run silently loaded the pinned unpatched candidate 574cfb4d… while claiming to test the six-patch stack; the evidence JSON only recorded library names.
bug.root_cause: Staged patched builds keep their real wrapper at the top level (candidate-stripped.so 095c9a81…; candidate.so is the unstripped copy) while native-probe/ is copied from the pinned build.
bug.affected: Full-stack render runs against staged builds. The pinned-build receipts (e.g. docs/evidence/2026-10-22-vulkan-wrapper-render-orchestrated.json) are unaffected because that build's top level and native-probe/ copy are both 574cfb4d….

conclusions: The staging bug is fixed: the full-stack phases staged candidate-stripped.so sha256 095c9a81… (not native-probe/candidate.so 574cfb4d…), with the resolution order recorded and no pinned-candidate warning.

The stack binary is demonstrably loaded: under the default encoded convention the patched candidate's host-cpu sRGB output no longer matches encoded (73 LSB) and matches the linearised expectation byte-exactly, while the pinned build still passes encoded.
Patched candidate host-cpu sRGB is byte-exact against the independent linearised reference on both the 4 KB (API 36) and 16 KB (API 37) AVDs (0 mismatch, max delta 0 for BC1_SRGB and BC3_SRGB).
The unpatched baseline is the negative control in linear mode: baseline host-cpu sRGB fails the linear expectation by 73 LSB on both AVDs, as expected for a build without the srgb-storage patch.

All other conventions are unchanged: compute/compute-view sRGB render linearised values within 1 LSB; UNORM compute/compute-view pass (BC1 byte-exact, BC3 within 1 LSB of the bcdec-derived reference); RGBA8 controls byte-exact; native llvmpipe/gfxstream within 3 LSB.
Pinned-build behaviour is unchanged (574cfb4d…, 31/31, 15 byte-exact, default encoded), and --dir on the earlier evidence directories still reports 31/31 with 15 byte-exact.

16 KB AVD VaporProbe37K16B (page size 16384, Android 17/API 37, gfxstream (llvmpipe)) shows the same stack result as the 4 KB AVD: 29 pass / 2 expected baseline-negative-control failures, candidate host-cpu sRGB byte-exact linear.
limitations: Software Vulkan emulator only: llvmpipe on the 4 KB AVD and gfxstream (llvmpipe) on the 16 KB AVD; no physical GPU, phone or Adreno/KGSL result.
Synthetic deterministic textures and a single fullscreen triangle with a nearest sampler; no depth, blending, mip or array-layer coverage.

The 2 failures in each stack phase are declared negative controls (unpatched baseline in linear mode; patched candidate in encoded mode), not product defects; they are recorded with --allow-failures and listed per case.
Host-cpu sRGB is only observed through this render pipeline; no sampling of real game textures or shader permutations.
The stack build is a scratch build under /Users/cheng/staging-stack/wrapper-build-patched, not packaged or installed by Vapor.

The expected images use the pinned host bcdec decoder as the reference; BC3 differs from the earlier Python-reference receipt by 1 LSB on 194/4096 decoded bytes, as recorded in docs/evidence/2026-10-22-vulkan-wrapper-render-orchestrated.json.
No performance claims; no commit or upstream action was taken.
